STANZA I
Not to our names, thou only Just and True
Not to our names, thou only Just and True,
Not to our worthless names is glory due;
Thy power and grace, thy truth and justice claim
Immortal honours to thy sovereign Name:
Shine thro' the earth from heaven, thy blest abode,
Nor let the heathens say, "And where's your God?"
The psalm it sets
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 115, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness. 2Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” 3Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases. 4Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men. … 14 more verses PSALM 115 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 115
